responsibility: This header defines the core data structures, enums, metadata records, and inline helpers that underpin the AArch64 SVE builtin framework. It specifies how intrinsic names are decomposed into base functions, mode suffixes, type suffixes, and predication kinds; declares the function_instance, function_shape, and function_base interfaces; records call-property flags and vector-type classes; and provides the common APIs that registration, overload resolution, checking, folding, and expansion code use to reason about SVE ACLE builtins.
same_name_distinction: In the aarch64-sve-builtins trio, this header provides the core API and data-model definitions—enums, metadata structures, and class interfaces such as function_instance, function_shape, and function_base—used by the framework. The .cc file implements the framework, while the .def file supplies the declarative builtin inventory and metadata inputs.
